text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(There might be plenty of Umamusume
who are stronger than me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(There might be plenty of other Umamusume
who can run more captivatingly than me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(When it comes to this feeling alone, I refuse to lose
to any Umamusume! I will——)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I love running! I love it so much!!
I looooooove it so muuuuuch--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The home runner holds off the overseas contenders!
Ines Fujin takes 1st place! A complete and utter victory!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
I-NES! I-NES!
I-NES! I-NES!
I-NES! I-NES!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! Ahaha!
Jeez, you're all getting way too hyped up...
Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did everyone have nice dreams?
I had so many today—
